translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Taani P'awuloosi, Yesuusi Kiristtoosa diraw k'ashuwaan de'iyaawenne nu ishaa S'imootoosi, nuunanna ootsiyaa nuuni siik'iyaa Pilimoonaw,
ne gollen shiik'iyaa ammaniyaawanttoo, nu michchati Afibissinne nuunanna ittippe de'iyaa Kiristtoosa wotaadaraa Arkkipoosaw ha dabddaabbiyaa s'aafeetto.
S'oossaa nu Aawuwaappenne nu Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosappe aad'd'o keekatetsaynne sarotetsay hinttenttoo gido.
Pilimoona Siik'uwaanne Ammanuwaa
Neeni S'oossaa asatuwaa siik'iyaawaanne Godaa Yesuusa ammaniyaawaa taani sisiyaa diraw, S'oossaa woossaade neena hassayiyaa wode ubbaan, ta S'oossaa galatay.
Neeni ne ammanuwaa haratuwaanna shaakkiyaawe nuw Kiristtoosi Yesuusa baggana yiyaa lo"obaa ubbaa erissana mala, taani S'oossaa woossay.
Ayaw gooppe, S'oossaa asatuwaa wozanay ne kiitaan minneedda diraw, ta ishaw, taani ne siik'uwaan daro nashechchaanne mentsetsuwaa demmaad.
Anaasimoosi Pilimoonakko Simmeedda Simuwaa
Hewaa diraw, neeni ootsanaw bessiyaawaa ootsana mala, taani neena azazanaw Kiristtoosa baggana s'alooppekka,
Taani P'awuloosi c'imeeddawe, Kiristtoosi Yesuusaw ha"ikka k'ashuwaan de'iyaawe, siik'uwaa diraw, neena woossay.
Taani k'ashuwaan de'aadde aw aawuwaa gideedda ta na'aa Anaasimoosa
diraw, neena woossay.
I kase neena go"enna; shin ha"i neenakka taanakka tumu go"ee.
Taani wozanaappe dosiyaa Anaasimoosa neekko yeddowe ta wozanaa yeddowaa. Taani wonggalaa diraw k'ashetta utta de'ishshin, neena kochchiide, taana maaddana mala, ta matan Aa ashshanaw koyyay.
Shin neeni ne sheniyaadan ootsanaawaa koyyayippe attin, neenanna zorettennan wolk'k'an ayinne ootsanaw koyyikke.
Anaasimoosi guutsa wodiyaa neeppe shaaketteeddawe, ooni eri simmiide, ubbaa wodekka neenanna de'anaassenttonne.

Simmi hawaappe sintsaw Anaasimoosi ayiliyaa gidenna; shin ayiliyaappe I loytsi aad'd'ee; I taw ay keena siik'o ishee! K'ay I new asaa baggaanakka Godaa baggaanakka ay keena aad'd'eedda ishaa gidanddeeshsha!
Simmi neeni taana ne laggetsaa giyaawaa gidooppe, taana mokkiyaawaadan, Aa mokka.
I new bayizzeeddabay woy Aa bolla new ac'uu de'ooppe, taappe c'igaa akka.
He ac'uwaa taani c'iggana gaade, taani P'awuloosi ta kushiyan s'aafay. Neeni taw ne shemppuwaa ac'ota utteeddawaa taani neena hassayissanaw koshshenna.
Ee, ta ishaw, Godaa baggana neeppe maaduwaa demmanaw koyyay. Kiristtoosa baggana taana mentsetsa.
Taani geeddawaappe daruwaa neeni ootsanaawaa eraade, k'ay ne taw azazettanawaakka ammanaade, hawaa new s'aafay.
K'ay hinttenttu ellekka taw imatsay shemppiyaa golliyaa giigissite. Ayaw gooppe, S'oossay hinttenttu woosan taana hinttenttoo guyye zaariide immana gaade k'oppay.
Wurssetsaa Sarotaa
Kiristtoosi Yesuusa diraw, taananna k'ashuwaan de'iyaa Eppaafiri neena saro saro gee.
K'ay taananna ittippe ootsiyaa Mark'k'oossi, Ariss's'irokoosi, Deemaasinne Luk'aasi neena saro saro giino.
Godaa Yesuusi Kiristtoosa aad'd'o keekatetsay hinttenttu ayyaanaanna gido.

footnotes.text: Anaasimoosa: Giyaa suntsaa biletsay, Giriikiyaa k'aalaan go'iyaawaa woy maaddiyaawaa guussaa.
